meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: Claude使用COBRApy库读取和构建代谢模型（SBML/JSON/YAML），执行FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样等分析，计算最小培养基并修补模型，输出数值结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求加载或构建代谢模型、做通量分析（FBA/FVA）、进行基因敲除模拟时触发。

say.text: 加载textbook模型，做FBA，输出最大生长速率。
对textbook模型做单基因敲除筛选，列出必需基因。
计算最小培养基，要求支持50%最大生长。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the COBRApy library to load and build metabolic models (SBML/JSON/YAML), run FBA, pFBA, FVA, gene/deletion screens, flux sampling, minimal media calculations, and gap-filling, returning numerical results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to load or build metabolic models, run flux analyses such as FBA/FVA, perform gene or reaction knockout simulations, or design growth media.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model, run FBA, and show the maximum growth rate.
say_en.note: Runs model.optimize and prints the objective value.

say_en.text: Perform single-gene deletion screening on the textbook model and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Uses single_gene_deletion and filters growth below 0.01.

say_en.text: Compute a minimal medium that supports 50% of maximal growth.
